messages:
alex_support: FYI GreenGrid (acct GG-442) reached out — procurement says they need a formal PO on file before we can issue the April invoice. They pasted PO# PG-2025-078 but say it must be on company letterhead/signed and our vendor code in their system. cc @mike_finance

olivia_sales: Ugh — we told them billing is self-serve but procurement pushed back. Do we have a W9/vendor onboarding info sent?

mike_finance: We don't have a W9 for GreenGrid in our vendor records. Also legal prefers not to issue revenue invoices until vendor onboarding + PO are official. I can prepare a pro forma (estimate) that procurement can attach to their PO process. Not a formal invoice.

emma_support: Customer says procurement needs our vendor code listed: RWI-027, plus remit address. They included this line in the email: 'please confirm vendor code and attach W9 and remit details to expedite PO issuance.'

olivia_sales: I can ping Katie (buyer) directly. Katie — can procurement accept a pro forma/estimate while they wait on signed PO? If so we can send that immediately.

katie_customer: yes — procurement will accept a formal quote/pro-forma with vendor code and amounts so they can attach it to their PO request. They still require the signed PO to be uploaded before accounts payable will release payment, but a pro-forma helps our internal approval flow. Please send ASAP.

mike_finance: Ok I'll generate a pro forma for the billing period (Apr 1–30) amount $9,250 and include RWI-027 + remit info. Note: we cannot mark it as an official invoice for recognition. ETA ~4–6 hours.

emma_support: Customer also asked that the invoice reference include their account GG-442 and the PO field left blank until they upload PG-2025-078 signed. I told them we'd provide the pro forma.

incident-bot: billing-SLA: reminder — requested customer docs should be acknowledged within 48h.

mike_finance: Sent pro forma (internal link): https://files.redwood.com/proforma/GG-442-0425.pdf — forwarding to Olivia to pass to Katie. Also flagged for expedited vendor onboarding with legal.

olivia_sales: got it, passing to Katie now and looping legal/ops for W9 + vendor code verification. Will follow up once procurement confirms PO upload. :thumbsup:

emma_support: marking thread status: awaiting PO upload from GreenGrid. If no PO in 7 business days, they warned deploy pause might start. Keeping ops aware.

katie_customer: confirmed received pro forma, procurement actioning. I'll update once PO PG-2025-078 is signed and uploaded to our vendor portal. Thanks for quick turnaround.

mike_finance: noted — once PO uploaded we will convert pro forma to official invoice and send to payments@greengrid.com. Leaving thread open until confirmed.

alex_support: thanks all. tagging @mike_finance @olivia_sales — please update when PO is in their portal so we can close the billing hold.
